observations.claim: The recovered r1 generator is written unchanged only after its 4319-byte length and recovered-source SHA-256 are checked. candidate-reader-r1 and the survival symlink are siblings under the temporary root, matching the original generator's ../survival imports and repo path.
observations.evidence: try block: source digest/length check, mkdirSync(candidateDir), symlinkSync(repo, join(temporary,'survival')), writeFileSync candidate.mjs, execFileSync using that path.
observations.limit: Static path reasoning only. This reviewer did not start a process or confirm Node resolution in the next runner.

observations.claim: The helper verifies bytes and SHA-256 for the regenerated r1 reader, field pins and private audit before editing headings. It verifies the expected old U11/U12 headings, changes only those two subject strings, serializes with the original two-space JSON plus final LF, and requires the known r2 reader SHA before formatting.
observations.evidence: Original-output loop followed by U11/U12 check and mutations, then candidateR2 hash check.
observations.limit: This is a fail-closed verification plan, not a report that this helper has already regenerated either hash. The recorded extractor-text hash alone is not substituted for output-hash equality.

observations.claim: Both sides are passed to the same format function after the reference r2 reader hash and exact shared notice are checked. String-valued text, mood, tag and locked_reason are appended directly and hashed in addField. Internal line breaks and original word contents are not normalized. The words statistic operates on a derived expression and does not alter the saved text.
observations.evidence: format/addField and common [['A', reference], ['B', candidate]] loop.
observations.limit: The new text adds explicit labels/separators. It is a new r3 presentation, not a byte reproduction of the missing old formatter output and not final game DOM text.

observations.claim: The formatter iterates every node.alternates entry without filtering and emits its variant identifier, state_dependent marker and text. Every node's complete continuations array is printed, retaining branches and cycles as links. Duplicate node IDs, invalid entry IDs and unresolved internal continuation targets fail preparation.
observations.evidence: for (const alt of node.alternates), addField alternate.variant/alt.text, destinations validation, CONTINUATIONS output and structure audit.
observations.limit: Static inspection of the formatter's expected schema only. This agent did not inspect the just-restored reference r2's actual 40 alternate records or execute an emitted-field count. Null/undefined values are skipped by addField, so this routine is not by itself a general arbitrary-schema completeness validator. The known fixed-reader schema and actual r3 field/structure outputs remain the basis of the ensuing result.

observations.claim: All true state_dependent, conditional_routing, check_authored and player_option flags are printed and retained in the structural audit. Alternative state_dependent is printed explicitly. The shared notice preserves the non-execution, non-simultaneity and inherited-parent-gate qualifications.
observations.evidence: flags fixed-key filter, AUTHORED FLAGS, ALTERNATIVE state marker, reader.notice.
observations.limit: False top-level flags are represented by absence from the printed true-flag list, not by four explicit false strings. A missing true flag is not observed here; absence must not be interpreted as proof of unconditional runtime availability. The readable document is not a lossless serialization of every JSON property.

observations.claim: Sorting a copy with localeCompare('en',{numeric:true}) addresses the observed candidate storage order: the parent N001 is displayed before N001C1, N001C2 and subsequent N002. Raw node objects, original arrays, text, alternate order and continuation arrays are not mutated by this change.
observations.evidence: const displayNodes = [...unit.nodes].sort(...); for (const node of displayNodes). Mechanical v1/v2 source comparison finds no other substantive changes.
observations.limit: Node-ID order is an authored index, not a topological or played route. The notice, ENTRIES and CONTINUATIONS must remain attached, especially where branches point backward or skip numbered nodes. The sort does not prove a linear story or a selected option.

observations.claim: The helper writes full readers and readable prose beneath RUNNER_TEMP. Its public report contains counts, hashes, identifiers and statuses; generator stdout is summarized by byte length/hash. It does not print reference text or exception messages. Caught preparation errors set a failure status and process.exitCode=1; report-write failure also remains nonzero.
observations.limit: This describes this file's data flow. The surrounding workflow's artifact upload configuration was not part of this input and was not newly audited.
